rules.name: Function/variable names convey intent without comments
rules.fix: Rename functions/variables to clearly describe their purpose. Replace generic names (data, result, handle) with domain-specific names.

rules.name: Module boundaries align with domain concepts
rules.fix: Split modules that mix concerns. Each file should map to one domain concept.

rules.name: Control flow is linear and predictable (max nesting <= 3)
rules.fix: Extract nested blocks into helper functions. Use early returns instead of nested if/else.

rules.name: Abstraction levels are consistent within modules
rules.fix: Move low-level operations into utility functions. Keep orchestration and implementation at separate levels.

rules.name: Dependency direction is acyclic (no circular imports)
rules.fix: Break circular dependencies by extracting shared types/interfaces into a separate module.

rules.name: Each module has a single clear responsibility
rules.fix: Split multi-responsibility modules. One file = one reason to change.

rules.name: Configuration is separated from logic
rules.fix: Move hardcoded URLs, magic numbers, and constants into config files or environment variables.

rules.name: Common patterns are extracted, not duplicated
rules.fix: Extract repeated code blocks (>3 lines) into shared utility functions.

rules.name: All async paths have error handling
rules.fix: Add try/catch blocks to all async functions. Add .catch() to promise chains.

rules.name: Input boundaries are validated at module edges
rules.fix: Add input validation to all public functions that accept external data.

rules.name: Mutable state is minimized (let/total ratio < 10%)
rules.fix: Replace let with const where possible. Restructure code to avoid reassignment.

rules.name: Edge cases handled (null, empty, overflow)
rules.fix: Add guard clauses for null/undefined. Use optional chaining and default parameters.

rules.name: Public APIs are minimal and well-bounded
rules.fix: Remove unnecessary exports. Use index.js as clean public API surface.

rules.name: Return types are consistent and predictable
rules.fix: Standardize return shapes across similar functions.

rules.name: Error responses follow a uniform schema
rules.fix: Unify error format: { error: { message, code, status } } across all modules.

rules.name: Adding a new component requires minimal file changes
rules.fix: Ensure plugin/adapter patterns so new features require only new files + config registration.

rules.name: Adding a new route/endpoint requires only route + registration
rules.fix: Middleware/pipeline should apply automatically. Only route file + registration needed.

rules.name: Data schema changes don't cascade across modules
rules.fix: Decouple data consumers. Each module should parse only what it needs.
